metadata.title: Independent developer and product builder
metadata.description: A multilingual personal website built for thoughtful design, speed, and long-term maintainability.

home.title: Turning clear ideas into digital products with character.
home.subtitle: A home for my projects, writing, and experiments—built from the start for multiple languages, secure accounts, and steady growth.
home.cardTitle: Built for real products, not just demos.
home.foundationTitle: Designed to grow from day one
home.featureStackText: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, and reusable shadcn/ui components.
home.featureSecurityText: Server-side auth checks, Zod input validation, and Supabase Row Level Security.
home.featureI18nText: Chinese, English, and Japanese each have localized routes, copy, and SEO metadata.

about.title: Good work starts with curiosity and is finished with patience.
about.description: I work where design, engineering, and product thinking meet—turning complex problems into calm, reliable experiences.
about.body: Use this space for your story, skills, values, and way of working. The content layer is already localized and can later connect to Supabase or a headless CMS.
